stance: Inflation pipeline is hot but cooling at the margin. October CPI core rose 0.30% m/m (Sep 0.34%) and headline 0.35% (Sep 0.65%). October PPI headline rose 0.35% m/m (Sep revised 1.41%) and core 0.33% (Sep 0.82%), though PPI y/y is 6.52% headline and 5.04% core. September core PCE was 0.32% m/m (3.12% y/y), 1.1pp above the 2% target. Cuts stay pushed back. A softer view needs core m/m near 0.2% to 0.25% across CPI and PPI. October consensus figures are unconfirmed.
